chapter: Fellow musicians: Kirk, Bunk, Parker, McShann
title: Lester Young in Kansas City
summary: Lovett only talked with Lester Young in Kansas City, and Goodwin knew him as a very young, learning player.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Tell me, of course Basie's band had so many great ones on it. What contact did you have with Lester Young, Baby?
You didn't know him here in Kansas City at all?
I knew him here in Kansas City, yes, but that was the first time I ever met him, here in Kansas City.
Did you know him, I mean to talk to?
Oh yes, I talked with him a lot of
Wasn't he on the band in Newark, Basie's band, when you joined it?
No, he wasn't on the band then.
Did you know Lester Young, Crook?
What kind of a man was he, rather briefly, because we're going to come to the end of this side of the tape?
Well, let's see, Lester was a -- when I first met Lester, he was very young and he was learning to play. This is before he even joined any kind of a big band.
He was not a native of Kansas City?
No. He came here and I forget now -- I can't think of where he's from.
But you knew him when he was starting out and learning?
